admission_scope.no_expert_gate_for_source_equality: Source BIDS equality is a provenance target; no clinical interpretation is required to calculate it.
admission_scope.preserved_v1: No outcome-conditioned re-selection, re-rendering, registration or test inspection.
admission_scope.scoped_nonclinical_engineering_candidate: PERMITTED_WITH_LIMITATIONS per root technical review and standing researcher mandate; requires source-bound integration and normal model/resource preflight.

focused_tests.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_visit_correspondence.py tests/test_vero_recipe.py tests/test_volume.py -p no:cacheprovider

independent_technical_render_review.limitation: Face, neck and skull remain visibly present. This is WHOLE-HEAD image correspondence, not brain-only morphology. Nonbrain/intensity/acquisition shortcuts remain uncontrolled.
independent_technical_render_review.observed: Actual distinct multiview MRI, visible brain coverage, nonempty consistent three-plane panels, no printed patient identifiers, scan dates or targets.
independent_technical_render_review.reviewer: root Codex independent coordinator; same underlying model family, not Claude
independent_technical_render_review.scope: Two deterministic first-by-opaque-ID train/internal-dev rendered pairs, selected without outcomes; technical rendering only.

integration_contract.prompt_boundary: Pass only fixed question and one pair image into model. Ground truth, opaque patient keys, source hashes and cycle IDs remain hidden metadata.
integration_contract.source_equality_reference: Opaque query patient key equals opaque candidate patient key; distinct cross-visit source SHA256 required.
integration_contract.source_route_binding: Explicit typed dispatch required. Do not coerce source to ds007045 or reuse tumor/task labels.
integration_contract.statistical_unit: Two-person matched cycle; 12 train and 4 internal-dev clusters, not 48 and 16 independent people.
integration_contract.strict_format: Reuse existing Vero _answer_and_format; accuracy gated by nonzero valid tag-format score; score = 0.8 * exact same/different accuracy + 0.2 * Vero formatting.

limitations: No expert visual answerability claim; technical renders and CPU controls are insufficient for admission.
Source scanner model absent; manufacturer/TR/TE/age/sex matching cannot rule out all acquisition shortcuts.
Labels are BIDS identity correspondence, not diagnosis, clinical longitudinal change or independent-patient generalization.
Negative cases connect two people; matched cycle is the conservative statistical cluster.
mission_alignment: Prepare a distinct metadata-hidden MRI visit-correspondence task for systematic Vero multi-task transfer; not a biological change verifier.

shortcut_diagnostics.interpretation: Spatial success is a simple image baseline, not proof of MRI understanding. Nonspatial success is an unresolved shortcut warning; small dev denominator prevents generalization claims.
